description: ROS 2 diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray exported as a JSON array. A status level is mapped to a target event-kind string by the codes diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticStatus defines (OK 0, WARN 1, ERROR 2, STALE 3). The strings are this file's declaration, not a registered vocabulary: validating them against one is deferred (Deploy ADR 0010). Copy the file to map a vendor's own names.
